grains.rolling_30: 30 consecutive days ending on the last calendar day of the named month
grains.calendar_year: Jan 1 to Dec 31 of the named year
grains.retail_fy: Feb 1 of year Y through Jan 31 of year Y+1

tasks.question_en: What was the year-over-year growth rate of store net sales in the Sports category for February 2000?
tasks.question_zh: 2000年2月门店净销售额 in the Sports category的同比增长率是多少？

paired_definitions.sql:
WITH cur AS (
      SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS amt FROM msb_store_sales
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-02-01' AND DATE '2000-02-29' AND (i_category = 'Sports')
    ),
    prev AS (
      SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS amt FROM msb_store_sales
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-02-01' AND DATE '1999-02-28' AND (i_category = 'Sports')
    )
    SELECT (cur.amt - prev.amt) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prev.amt, 0) FROM cur, prev

WITH cur AS (
